ankle-mobility.description: Controlled ankle drills that move the knee over the toes while the heel stays grounded.
tips: Move slowly through a comfortable range

bear-plank.description: Hold a quadruped plank with the knees hovering just above the floor.

bicycle-crunches.description: Alternate bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.

bulgarian-split-squats.description: Perform split squats with the rear foot elevated on a stable surface.

burpees.description: Move from standing to a plank and return explosively to standing with a jump.
tips: Brace before placing the hands down

calf-raises.description: Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause at the top, and lower under control.
tips: Use a full range of motion

cat-cow.description: Alternate gently between spinal flexion and extension from a hands-and-knees position.
tips: Move one vertebra at a time
Match the motion to steady breathing

copenhagen-side-plank-left.description: Hold a left-side plank with the upper leg supported on a bench or stable surface.

copenhagen-side-plank-right.description: Hold a right-side plank with the upper leg supported on a bench or stable surface.

cross-body-mountain-climbers.description: From a high plank, alternate driving each knee toward the opposite elbow.
tips: Keep the shoulders over the hands

db-lateral-raise-alternating-lunge-front.description: Using two dumbbells, combine a lateral raise, alternating lunge, and front raise in sequence.
tips: Keep the knees tracking over the toes

db-rdl-curl-squat-thrust.description: Using two dumbbells, combine a Romanian deadlift, curl, squat, and overhead thrust.

db-skull-crusher-hip-thrust.description: Using one dumbbell, combine a hip thrust with a lying triceps skull crusher.

db-squat-curl-front-raise.description: Using one dumbbell, combine a squat, biceps curl, and front raise.
tips: Move through each phase with control

dead-bug.description: Lower opposite arm and leg from a supine tabletop position while keeping the lower back controlled.
tips: Press the lower back gently into the floor

deep-squat-hold.description: Hold the bottom of a comfortable deep squat with the feet grounded.

deep-squat-stretch.description: Use a supported deep squat to mobilize the hips, groin, and ankles.
tips: Keep the knees aligned with the toes

dumbbell-biceps-curls.description: Curl dumbbells toward the shoulders while keeping the upper arms mostly still.
tips: Keep the elbows close to the body

dumbbell-chest-flies.description: From a supported lying position, open the dumbbells wide and bring them together over the chest.
tips: Keep a soft bend in the elbows

dumbbell-renegade-rows.description: From a dumbbell high plank, alternate rowing one dumbbell toward the ribs.
tips: Keep the hips as square as possible

dumbbell-reverse-flies.description: From a hip hinge, raise dumbbells out to the sides to target the rear shoulders and upper back.

dumbbell-triceps-kickbacks.description: From a supported or hinged position, extend the elbows to move the dumbbells behind the body.

flutter-kicks.description: Lie on the back and alternate small up-and-down leg kicks while bracing the core.

glute-stretch.description: A controlled stretch for the glutes and outer hips.

hamstring-curls.description: Curl the heels toward the glutes using a machine, band, ball, or sliders.

hamstring-stretch.description: A controlled stretch for the muscles along the back of the thighs.

hanging-knee-raises.description: Hang from a bar and raise the knees toward the torso; use lying leg raises when no bar is available.
tips: Curl the pelvis upward at the top

heavy-db-farmer-carry-march.description: Hold heavy dumbbells at the sides and march in place with a tall, braced posture.
tips: Keep the ribs stacked over the pelvis

heavy-russian-twists.description: Rotate the torso side to side while holding a challenging weight in front of the body.

heel-taps.description: From a crunch position, alternate reaching each hand toward the same-side heel.

high-plank-hold.description: Hold the top of a push-up with arms straight and the body in one line.

hip-flexor-stretch.description: A kneeling or standing stretch for the front of the hip.

hip-openers.description: Controlled mobility movements through multiple hip positions and ranges.

hip-thrusts.description: Drive the hips upward from a supported position and squeeze the glutes at the top.

hollow-hold.description: Hold a hollow-body position with the lower back pressed toward the floor.
tips: Shorten the lever if the back lifts

hollow-rocks.description: Maintain a hollow-body shape while rocking smoothly from shoulders to hips.

jump-squats.description: Explode upward from a squat and land softly before the next repetition.
tips: Land with knees tracking over toes

leg-raises.description: Raise and lower straight or slightly bent legs while keeping the torso stable.
tips: Lower only as far as form allows

mountain-climbers.description: From a high plank, alternate driving the knees forward toward the chest.
tips: Keep the shoulders over the hands

plank.description: Hold a forearm plank with the body in a straight line from head to heels.

plank-hip-dips.description: From a forearm plank, rotate the hips gently from side to side toward the floor.

plank-shoulder-taps.description: From a high plank, alternate tapping the opposite shoulder with one hand.

pull-ups.description: Hang from a bar and pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower under control.

push-ups.description: Lower the chest from a high plank and press back to straight arms while maintaining body alignment.
tips: Keep the elbows at a comfortable angle

reverse-crunches.description: Curl the pelvis toward the ribs by drawing the knees toward the chest.

romanian-deadlifts.description: Hinge at the hips with a neutral spine, lower the load to a hamstring stretch, and stand tall.
tips: Keep the load close to the legs

shoulder-mobility.description: Controlled shoulder movements through comfortable ranges of flexion, rotation, and extension.

shoulder-triceps-lateral-raise-finisher.description: Complete 100 combined total reps of dumbbell shoulder presses, dumbbell triceps extensions, and dumbbell lateral raises without scheduled rest.
tips: Divide the 100 reps among all three movements
Use weights that allow clean repetitions

side-bends.description: Gently bend the torso from side to side to mobilize the lateral trunk.

side-plank-left.description: Hold a left-side forearm plank with the body in a straight line.

side-plank-reach-through-left.description: From a left-side plank, rotate the upper arm under the torso and return to an open position.

side-plank-reach-through-right.description: From a right-side plank, rotate the upper arm under the torso and return to an open position.

side-plank-right.description: Hold a right-side forearm plank with the body in a straight line.

slow-bicycle-crunches.description: Perform bicycle crunches slowly with deliberate rotation and full leg extension.

squats.description: Lower the hips between the feet and return to standing while keeping the feet grounded.
tips: Keep the knees tracking over the toes

standing-oblique-crunch-left.description: From standing, shorten the left side of the torso by bringing the left ribs and hip toward each other.

standing-oblique-crunch-right.description: From standing, shorten the right side of the torso by bringing the right ribs and hip toward each other.

superman-hold.description: Lie face down and hold the arms, chest, and legs slightly lifted from the floor.
tips: Lift only as high as comfortable

thoracic-rotations.description: Rotate through the upper back while keeping the hips controlled.
tips: Follow the moving hand with the eyes

toe-touches.description: From a supine position with legs raised, reach the hands toward the toes by lifting the shoulder blades.

v-ups.description: Raise the torso and legs together to form a V shape, then lower under control.

walking-lunges.description: Step forward into alternating lunges while traveling continuously.

wall-sit.description: Hold a seated position against a wall with the feet planted and knees bent.
tips: Keep the back against the wall

weighted-crunches.description: Perform controlled crunches while holding a plate or dumbbell securely.
tips: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis

weighted-russian-twists.description: Rotate the torso side to side while holding a plate or dumbbell.
tips: Keep the load close to the torso

weighted-sit-ups.description: Perform sit-ups while holding a plate or dumbbell securely at the chest.
tips: Avoid jerking through the lower back

windshield-wipers.description: With the torso braced and legs raised, lower the legs from side to side under control.
tips: Use bent knees to reduce difficulty

wood-chops-left.description: Move a load diagonally across the body toward the left using controlled trunk rotation.

wood-chops-right.description: Move a load diagonally across the body toward the right using controlled trunk rotation.

worlds-greatest-stretch.description: A lunge-based mobility sequence combining hip opening and thoracic rotation.
